question: In 2019, CEPOL trained Algerian security forces on information-gathering from open sources. What other training and workshops have EU agencies provided (CEPOL, the European Union Agency for Law Enforcement Cooperation (Europol), the European Border and Coast Guard Agency (Frontex) or others) for Algerian security forces since 2019, either bilaterally or as part of regional programmes, and what equipment has been supplied?
answer: EN on behalf of the European Commission (21.2.

2025) As the question regarding the European Union Agency for Law Enforcement Training (CEPOL) and its cooperation with Algeria falls entirely under the responsibility of CEPOL, the European Union Agency for Law Enforcement Cooperation and the European Border and Coast Guard Agency, the Commission has asked these Agencies to provide an answer to the question raised by the Honourable Member.
The Commission will send the Agencies’ reply to the Honourable Member as soon as possible.
